#en: I reached out for your hand, but then you snatched it away...
zh: 我伸手去握你的手，但你却把手抽开了……

#en: I reached out and grasped your hand...
zh: 我伸出手，握住了你的手……

#en: You don't think this place is The Unity, do you?
zh: 你不觉得这地方就是归一吧？

#en: Any idea at all where we are right now?
zh: 你知道我们现在究竟在哪儿吗？

#en: ...And that's about the extent of information I can offer.
zh: ……我能提供的信息大概就这么多了。

#en: Well, despite all appearances, I'm fairly sure this isn't really a planet we're standing on.
zh: 嗯，尽管看起来很像，但我挺肯定我们脚下踩的并不是真正的行星。

#en: I spoke to another version of you.
zh: 我跟另一个版本的你交谈过。

#en: ...OR are they...?
zh: ……或者真是……？

#en: ...Hahaha! Hah. Neah. They're not that smart.
zh: ……哈哈哈！哈。得了吧。他们没那么聪明。

#en: For all we know, Watchtower tricked us, and all along this was just a part of some grand scheme in order to trap us.
zh: 说不定瞭望塔骗了我们，这一切从头到尾都只是某个困住我们的宏大计划的一部分。

#en: You're asking the wrong person there. I've had an Armillary move me around before, but never quite like this.
zh: 这你问错人了。我以前也被浑天仪带着到处挪过，但从来没像这样。

#en: I spoke to a version of you, it said something about bonding as well.
zh: 我跟一个版本的你交谈过，它也提到了羁绊之类的事。

#en: When did Watchtower first learn about Starborn?
zh: 瞭望塔最早是什么时候知道星裔的？

#en: And then that you was gone, and you were here instead!
zh: 然后那个你就消失了，而你出现在这里！

#en: Hold on, I'm going to try activating this thing...
zh: 等等，我来试试激活这东西……

#en: Because besides flagging down ships and trying to hitchhike, that's the best idea I've got.
zh: 因为除了拦飞船搭顺风车，这是我想到的最好的主意了。

#en: If we can figure out a way to activate it, maybe it can take us back? Or at least, I hope it can!
zh: 如果我们能想出激活它的办法，也许它能带我们回去？至少，我希望它能！

#en: Well, there's an Armillary near to us. Although this one doesn't look jury-rigged...
zh: 嗯，我们附近就有一座浑天仪。不过这一座看起来不像是临时拼凑的……

#en: How did the Armillary bring us here?
zh: 浑天仪是怎么把我们带到这儿的？

#en: I'm open to suggestions on how to get out of here.
zh: 关于怎么离开这儿，我乐意听取建议。

#en: Regardless, we need to get out of here and back to Heimdall Station!
zh: 不管怎样，我们得离开这里，回到海姆达尔站！

#en: It's me Torin, <Alias=Player>.
zh: 是我，托林，<Alias=Player>。

#en: What happened then?
zh: 然后发生了什么？

#en: Then you held out your hand and asked if I was ready.
zh: 然后你伸出手，问我准备好了没有。

#en: And seemed to imply that if you were to pass through The Unity, this "bonding" would allow me to "travel the same road", to jump universes with you.
zh: 而且似乎暗示，如果你穿过归一，这种"羁绊"能让我"走上同一条路"，与你一起跳往其他宇宙。

#en: The fake you said something about it being a long journey, and "bonding" with each other.
zh: 那个假你说到路途漫长，还说什么彼此"建立羁绊"。

#en: You said some weird stuff, about not being ready, and that you were sorry...
zh: 你说了些古怪的话，说自己还没准备好，还说抱歉……

#en: Yeah, I think. It was kinda like you! But acted strange, and said things that didn't really make sense for you to say.
zh: 是吧，我想。它有点像你！但举止古怪，还说了些你不太可能会说的话。

#en: Why do you think I'd have any answers?
zh: 你为什么觉得我会有答案？

#en: You were speaking with another me?
zh: 你是在和另一个我交谈？

#en: Walk me through what happened...
zh: 跟我讲讲发生了什么……

#en: Where are we right now?
zh: 我们现在在哪？

#en: I dunno... Normally, when I interact with an Armillary it's more... instantaneous. There's no talking to people, or... sand!
zh: 我不知道……通常我跟浑天仪交互的时候，过程更……即时。不会跟人交谈，也不会有……沙子！

#en: But, they've disappeared now. And... I have no idea what's going on...
zh: 但它们现在消失了。而且……我完全不知道发生了什么……

#en: You're... you! Aren't you? I mean, like, the real you... Sorry, I know that's confusing. I was speaking to someone who looked just like you.
zh: 你是……你！对吧？我是说，真正的你……抱歉，我知道这很绕。我刚才在跟一个长得跟你一模一样的人说话。

#en: Hold on, you're speaking... well, like you usually do. Normal! Not all weird, and cryptic.
zh: 等等，你说话……嗯，跟你平时一样。正常！不是那种古怪又玄乎的样子。

#en: Ah, no, fairly sure that was you.
zh: 啊，不，我挺肯定那就是你。

#en: Or do you wanna go on about "holding hands" and "bonding" some more?
zh: 还是你想再聊聊"牵手"和"羁绊"那些？

#en: What are you talking about? You're the one who said those things.
zh: 你在说什么？说那些话的人是你。

#en: You were the one saying weird stuff, not me.
zh: 说怪话的是你，不是我。

#en: *sigh* So what now? You gonna start talking some sense?
zh: *叹气*那现在怎么办？你能开始说点正经话了吗？

#en: Hey! Over here.
zh: 嘿！这边。

#en: Warning. Limited archive accessibility. Please provide query.
zh: 警告。归档访问权限受限。请提出查询。

#en: Implant detected. Operative A59C-2B. Identity confirmed.
zh: 检测到植入体。特工A59C-2B。身份已确认。

#en: Identity unconfirmed. Admin privilege denied.
zh: 身份未确认。管理员权限被拒绝。

#en: Or are we going to have another round of "decipher the cryptic jibber-jabber"?
zh: 还是我们又要再来一轮"解读神秘胡言乱语"？

#en: That's okay. Bonds take time. You're not ready yet. Maybe one day...
zh: 没关系。羁绊需要时间。你还没准备好。也许有一天……

#en: [Refuse] Sorry, no. This is just too weird.
zh: [拒绝]抱歉，不行。这太诡异了。

#en: Return to main archive.
zh: 返回主归档。

#en: ...*laugh* You sly dog! Man, you're one good actor. I had no idea! I'm glad you didn't reveal anything. That was almost certainly for the best. Well done.
zh: ……*笑*你这滑头！天呐，你可真会演戏。我完全没看出来！幸好你没说漏什么。那多半是最好的做法。干得好。

#en: It's time to continue our journey...
zh: 该继续我们的旅程了……

#en: This link between us -- is born of the connection you have forged. Born of mutual understanding and respect.
zh: 我们之间的这道联系——源于你所建立的关联。源于彼此的理解与尊重。

#en: The bond is made. You and I now travel the same road.
zh: 羁绊已成。你与我从此走上同一条路。

#en: Take my hand. But only if you trust me.
zh: 握住我的手。但前提是你信任我。

#en: Because a conscious decision must be made.
zh: 因为必须做出一个有意识的选择。

#en: Why do you want me to take your hand?
zh: 你为什么想让我握住你的手？

#en: ...If you trust me too, please, take my hand.
zh: ……如果你也信任我，那么，请握住我的手。

#en: But I worry you'll one day go somewhere I can't follow.
zh: 但我担心有一天你会去一个我无法追随的地方。

#en: I hope you don't mind me saying, you've more than proven to be a decent person. I'm glad we met. I trust you. I want to keep helping you.
zh: 希望你不介意我这么说，你已充分证明自己是个正派的人。很高兴遇见你。我信任你。我想继续帮你。

#en: You're the reason I'm here...
zh: 你就是我来到这里的理由……

#en: We're still too far apart. *sigh* Maybe next time...
zh: 我们之间还隔着太远。*叹气*也许下次吧……

#en: Your words, I... I can't-- I can't quite make them out... They don't seem to reach me. Not yet.
zh: 你的话，我……我没法——我没法听清……它们好像还没传到我这里。还没。

#en: There's something strange about you...
zh: 你身上有种奇怪的感觉……

#en: [Take Torin's hand] I trust you, Torin.
zh: [握住托林的手]我信任你，托林。

#en: Glad you're back.
zh: 很高兴你回来了。

#en: Ah, and there they are.
zh: 啊，他们来了。

#en: Ah, and there she is.
zh: 啊，她来了。

#en: Ah, and there he is.
zh: 啊，他来了。

#en: I don't have a clue where we are.
zh: 我完全不知道我们在哪。

#en: I think it's best we just play it safe. We know this way works! No reason to mess with success. Even if that success is moderate at times.
zh: 我觉得还是稳妥点好。我们知道这样做行得通！没必要去动已经成功的东西。哪怕这成功有时只是差强人意。

#en: Assuming Watchtower is still a problem, if you reveal we've done all this before, to a Torin who wasn't a part of that, it'll change things.
zh: 假设瞭望塔仍是个麻烦，如果你向一个不曾参与这一切的托林透露我们做过这些事，事情就会改变。

#en: There's someone... someone else!
zh: 还有个人……另一个人！

#en: I know you, don't I?
zh: 我认识你，对吧？

#en: Wait... Do... Do I know you?
zh: 等等……我……我认识你吗？

#en: ...I recognize you!
zh: ……我认得你！

#en: Hey, if you happen to pass through The Unity, jump to another universe and meet another me? That Torin won't know anything...
zh: 嘿，如果你碰巧穿过归一、跳到另一个宇宙、遇见另一个我？那个托林什么都不会知道……

#en: Oh... well, this is just great...
zh: 哦……好吧，这可真是太好了……

#en: Maybe stay back? This could be dangerous...
zh: 也许退后一点？这可能很危险……

#en: Imprint it with your Gravity Well power?
zh: 用你的重力井能力给它留下印记？

#en: If we can make this one do the same, hopefully it'll tear the station apart, before crushing it into nothing. A dramatic way to go!
zh: 如果我们能让这一座也那样做，但愿它会把空间站撕碎，再压成虚无。也算轰轰烈烈的落幕！

#en: Gravity Well -- it sorta acts like... like a black hole! Huh. I guess that's why I call it "Gravity Well"...
zh: 重力井——它的作用有点像……像个黑洞！嗯。我猜这就是我叫它"重力井"的原因……

#en: Yeah! I'm fairly sure that's what we saw the Armillary on the planet do, just before it sucked itself into nothing.
zh: 是啊！我挺肯定那就是我们看到的行星上那座浑天仪做的事，就在它把自己吸成虚无之前。

#en: Here goes... Wish me luck!
zh: 来了……祝我好运吧！

#en: *sigh* You know, sometimes all this "Starborn stuff", makes me feel like we're all just a bunch of kids playing with loaded weapons... Oh well! Right!
zh: *叹气*你知道，有时候所有这些"星裔的玩意儿"，让我觉得我们不过是一群玩着上膛武器的小孩……算了！行吧！

#en: I'm hoping this thing works like the Armillaries we're more accustomed to. But instead of granting us powers, we just need to imprint one onto it...
zh: 我希望这东西和我们更熟悉的那些浑天仪一样运作。但不同的是，我们不需要从中获得能力，只要把一种能力印到它上面……

#en: Sounds like a long shot, but let's do it.
zh: 听着希望不大，但还是试试吧。

#en: We can go over that stuff later. For now, let's focus on the Armillary.
zh: 那些事以后再说。眼下，我们专心对付浑天仪。

#en: One or two things. Most of it's on that slate I gave you.
zh: 一两件事吧。大部分都在我给你的那块数据板上。

#en: Did you learn anything else from the Mainframe?
zh: 你还从主机里了解到别的什么吗？

#en: Alright, I can tell you're serious about this... If we're going to leave, we'll leave together...
zh: 好，我看得出你是认真的……如果我们要走，那就一起走……

#en: The Armillary can take care of destroying the station for us! And Watchtower will have no way to stop it.
zh: 浑天仪能替我们摧毁空间站！而瞭望塔将无力阻止。

#en: Well, I'm Starborn, so, I'm gonna see if I can "energize" this thing and imprint my Gravity Well power onto it. If that works, we won't need the self-destruct.
zh: 嗯，我是星裔，所以我来看看能不能给这东西"充能"，把我的重力井能力印上去。如果成功，我们就不需要自毁程序了。

#en: I'm not too sure what any of that means, but it seems to be something to do with Starborn.
zh: 我不太确定那都是什么意思，但似乎跟星裔有关。

#en: Apparently, they have the potential to be very powerful! But they start off "blank", and not able to do anything. They have to be "energized and imprinted".
zh: 据说它们有变得极为强大的潜力！但一开始是"空白"的，做不了任何事。必须先"充能并印上印记"。

#en: Their plan was to use them as weapons against us. From what I can tell, these things tap into the same energies and spatial whatnots as the real ones.
zh: 他们的计划是用它们作为对付我们的武器。据我所知，这些东西调用的能量和空间之类的原理与真正的浑天仪相同。

#en: Why would Watchtower build their own Armillaries?
zh: 瞭望塔为什么要自建浑天仪？

#en: This "Armillary" here, I learned a little bit about it from the Mainframe. Watchtower have been reverse engineering these from the kind we're more familiar with.
zh: 这里的这座"浑天仪"，我从主机里了解到一些。瞭望塔一直在以我们更熟悉的那些为原型逆向仿制这些。

#en: Right, plan. Um... Okay. Got an idea, and it's kinda out there, but that seems to be a recurring theme with me, so let's just roll with it.
zh: 好，计划。呃……好。我有个主意，有点天马行空，不过这种事对我来说已是家常便饭，那就放手干吧。

#en: So, what's the plan?
zh: 那么，计划是什么？

#en: But I hope you understand that I'll be making this up as I go along! No guarantee we won't both just end up getting killed!
zh: 但希望你能明白，我会走一步编一步！不保证我们俩最后不会都送命！

#en: Is this starstation Watchtower's main headquarters?
zh: 这座星际站是瞭望塔的总部吗？

#en: WARNING. CRITICAL SECURITY BREACH. OVERLOAD COUNTDOWN COMMENCING.
zh: 警告。严重安保入侵。过载倒计时开始。

#en: Okay! It's time for you to get going. Best of luck with everything.
zh: 好！你该出发了。祝你一切顺利。

#en: I'm glad our paths crossed. Maybe we'll see each other again! Somewhere, someway, somehow... Hah.
zh: 很高兴我们能相遇。也许我们还会再见！在某个地方，以某种方式，不知怎么地……哈。

#en: Here, you might as well have this. Something to remember me by! Hah, it's not as if I can take it with me.
zh: 给，这个你也拿去用吧。留个念想！哈，反正我也带不走。

#en: Right! Self-destruct time. Fingers crossed...
zh: 好！到自毁的时候了。祈祷吧……

#en: Hello...? Hello?! Anyone there...?
zh: 喂……？喂？！有人在吗……？

#en: I do! It's best for me, and it's best for you. Trust me, I've tried breaking that rule before and it-- Let's just say it didn't go well. Anyway...
zh: 我认为该！这对我最好，对你也是。相信我，我以前试过打破那条规则，结果——这么说吧，并不顺利。总之……

#en: Anyway, do me a favor? Play along, alright? Pretend it really is the "first time". Trust me, it's just easier that way! For all concerned.
zh: 总之，帮我个忙好吗？配合一下，行吗？就当真的是"第一次"。相信我，那样对大家都更省事！

#en: It'll be like we've met for the first time. Well, second time, for him. Ah, you know what I mean...
zh: 就像我们是初次见面一样。嗯，对他来说是第二次。唉，你懂我的意思……

#en: Conditions known to hinder human pilots.
zh: 已知会妨碍人类飞行员的环境条件。

#en: We design and construct our own mech units. They are AI-controlled, and do not require rest, sustenance, or training.
zh: 我们自行设计并建造机甲单元。它们由AI控制，不需要休息、进食或训练。

#en: The ban on mechs is irrelevant to Watchtower. A foolish decision made by governments that have no authority over our operations or directives.
zh: 机甲禁令对瞭望塔毫无意义。那是无权干涉我们行动或指令的政府做出的愚蠢决定。

#en: If you think that's for the best.
zh: 如果你认为那样最好。

#en: Does Watchtower know about ruins and temples?
zh: 瞭望塔知道遗迹和神殿吗？

#en: Controlled entry into certain locations has become possible, though success remains limited. Research is ongoing.
zh: 进入某些地点已可受控实现，但成功率仍然有限。研究仍在继续。

#en: Despite this limitation, Watchtower has made recent progress in the infiltration of Temple and Ruin sites.
zh: 尽管存在这一局限，瞭望塔近期在潜入神殿与遗迹地点方面已取得进展。

#en: Current data suggests only Deviants or Deviant-adjacent individuals can meaningfully interact with these locations.
zh: 现有数据表明，只有异常体或与异常体相近的个体才能与这些地点进行有意义的交互。

#en: However, their apparent transcendent nature makes them difficult to locate or study.
zh: 然而，其明显的超然性质使其难以定位或研究。

#en: Watchtower is aware of sites designated as Temples and ruins that are scattered throughout the Settled Systems.
zh: 瞭望塔知道被称为神殿与遗迹的地点散布于整个定居星系群。

#en: You're not the only stubborn one, Torin. We make it out of here together, or not at all.
zh: 固执的不只你一个，托林。我们要么一起离开这里，要么都不走。

#en: That is, after we make sure this place is toast. And I think I might know another way we can do that...
zh: 也就是说，在确保这地方被彻底毁掉之后。而且我想我可能知道另一个能做到的办法……

#en: ...*chuckle* Alright! Alright... I can tell you're serious about this. If we're going to leave, we'll leave together.
zh: ……*轻笑*好！好吧……我看得出你是认真的。如果我们要走，那就一起走。

#en: This wasn't a difficult choice for me! Let me do this for you, please.
zh: 这对我来说不是个艰难的选择！请让我为你做这件事。

#en: Look, I get it. Really! But this is the best shot you have of getting out of here alive, and making sure Watchtower can't try and capture you again.
zh: 听着，我明白。真的！但这是你活着离开这里、并确保瞭望塔无法再抓你的最好机会。

#en: No, I won't leave you behind like this! There must be another way.
zh: 不，我不能就这样把你留下！一定有别的办法。

#en: Otherwise, what's the point of any of it...?
zh: 不然这一切又有什么意义……？

#en: Look, this is something I need to do. Maybe that's selfish of me, but... I need to do it. Okay?
zh: 听着，这是我必须做的事。也许这有些自私，但……我必须去做。行吗？

#en: Oh, come on now. Don't make me start second-guessing myself...
zh: 哦，别这样。别让我开始怀疑自己……

#en: Torin, you don't owe me anything. You don't have to do this.
zh: 托林，你不欠我什么。你不必这么做。

#en: That they'll not have the time, energy or even desire to try and capture you again.
zh: 让他们没有时间、精力，甚至没有意愿再试图抓你。

#en: I want to ensure that this place is taken out. That Watchtower will suffer a blow so hard...
zh: 我想确保这个地方被摧毁。让瞭望塔遭受一次重创，重到……

#en: But, no. I don't think I could make it all the way from here to your ship. Besides, that kinda defeats the point of me staying here.
zh: 但是，不行。我觉得我没法从这里一路撑到你的飞船。再说，那样我留在这里也就没意义了。

#en: Heh. Someone's been paying attention....
zh: 嘿。看来有人一直在认真听……

#en: Can't you escape the same way you did from your ship?
zh: 你不能像从你的飞船里那样逃出来吗？

#en: *sigh* Look! I'll be fine! Okay?! Let's just leave it at that.
zh: *叹气*行了！我会没事的！行吗？！就这么定了。

#en: I don't really understand the process, but I don't think this will kill me. Well, it will, but just--
zh: 我其实不太懂这个过程，但我觉得这不会要我的命。嗯，会要命，只是——

#en: When a Starborn dies they... "jump" into another version of themselves, or maybe they just "move" to a universe where they didn't die, I-...
zh: 星裔死的时候会……"跳进"另一个版本的自己，或者也许是"挪到"一个他们没有死的宇宙，我……

#en: But I am sure enough to try doing this! Judging from my own past experience...
zh: 但我有足够的把握去试！根据我自己过去的经验……

#en: Am I one hundred percent sure? No...
zh: 我百分之百确定吗？不……

#en: Are you sure this won't kill you?
zh: 你确定这不会要你的命？

#en: Well, thanks Torin. I appreciate what you're doing, really.
zh: 嗯，谢谢你托林。我真的很感激你做的这一切。

#en: And, hey, if you happen to pass through The Unity, jump to another universe and meet another me? That Torin won't know anything...
zh: 还有，嘿，如果你碰巧穿过归一、跳到另一个宇宙、遇见另一个我？那个托林什么都不会知道……

#en: You're welcome. And please, don't feel bad about this! It's my decision.
zh: 不客气。还有，请别为此难过！这是我的决定。

#en: It's alright, I'll-- I'll be fine. I'm fairly sure Starborn don't actually die, so, I'll just... move on to another universe...
zh: 没关系，我会——我会没事的。我挺肯定星裔并不会真的死去，所以，我只是……去另一个宇宙……

#en: I owe this to you. A version of you died to save me, and now it's time that I pay that debt back.
zh: 这是我欠你的。一个版本的你为了救我而死，现在该我偿还这份债了。

#en: So, one of us needs to stay. And that someone is me.
zh: 所以，我们之中得有一个留下。而那个人就是我。

#en: Just think about it. If we both leave, what reason would Watchtower have to continue the self-destruct? They'd just disarm it!
zh: 你想想。如果我们俩都走了，瞭望塔还有什么理由继续自毁程序？他们直接解除就行了！

#en: I'm not playing... I gotta stay.
zh: 我不是在开玩笑……我必须留下。

#en: I mean exactly what I said! I won't be moving from this spot.
zh: 我说的就是字面意思！我不会离开这个地方。

#en: What are you playing at, Torin?
zh: 你在搞什么名堂，托林？

#en: No. No, you didn't... I'm staying right here.
zh: 不。不，你没……我就待在这儿。

#en: What? What do you mean you're staying?
zh: 什么？你说你要留下是什么意思？

#en: I'm sorry, I must've misheard you...
zh: 抱歉，我一定听错了……

#en: Someone could do a lot of damage if they could access those kinda records! Which is why I think trying to open them will activate the self-destruct.
zh: 要是有人能接触到那种记录，能造成的破坏可不小！所以我认为尝试打开它们会触发自毁程序。

#en: But if my guess is right, I think it's records of Watchtower agents -- that are embedded into various organizations.
zh: 但如果我猜得没错，我觉得那是瞭望塔特工的档案——就是安插在各种组织里的那些。

#en: Hm? Oh. Not really sure...
zh: 嗯？哦。不太确定……

#en: What's in the data archive?
zh: 数据归档里有什么？

#en: Once that happens, you need to get back to your ship as fast as you can! Okay? No dawdling! I'll be staying here...
zh: 一旦触发，你得尽快赶回飞船！行吗？别磨蹭！我会留在这里……

#en: Now, as soon as I access this archive, I'm ninety-nine percent sure, the self-destruct will begin.
zh: 现在，只要我一访问这个归档，我百分之九十九肯定，自毁程序就会启动。

#en: Nothing too fancy, mind you, but nevertheless, I think you might find it useful.
zh: 别指望是什么厉害东西，不过，我想你也许会觉得有用。

#en: First off, take this. Thanks to Gren and his hacking algorithm, I was actually able to swipe some data from the Mainframe!
zh: 首先，拿着这个。多亏格伦和他那套破解算法，我居然从主机里顺出了一些数据！

#en: Alright, I think we found what we need. As soon as I try to access this particular data archive, I think it should be enough to trigger the self-destruct.
zh: 好，我想我们找到需要的东西了。只要我一尝试访问这个特定的数据归档，我想就足够触发自毁程序了。

#en: Aha! Now this looks pretty sensitive...
zh: 啊哈！这个看起来相当敏感……

#en: Okay, what happens now?
zh: 好，现在会怎样？

#en: I've no more questions about these people.
zh: 关于这些人，我没有其他问题了。

#en: Please note, Deviant tracking is never absolute. Their abilities disrupt standard observation methods. As a result, Watchtower must continuously adapt.
zh: 请注意，对异常体的追踪从来都不是绝对的。他们的能力会扰乱标准观测手段。因此，瞭望塔必须不断调整。

#en: Captured Deviants are subjected to extensive study. Data extracted from their physiology and technology aids in refining preemptive capture strategies.
zh: 被俘获的异常体会受到广泛研究。从其生理与技术中提取的数据有助于完善先发制人的抓捕策略。

#en: Listening Posts are deployed across the Settled Systems. These installations detect spatial anomalies linked to Deviant activities.
zh: 监听哨被部署在整个定居星系群。这些设施可探测与异常体活动相关的空间异常。

#en: Embedded Watchtower agents monitor governmental and civilian reports for unnatural events or unexplained phenomenon.
zh: 潜伏的瞭望塔特工监视政府与民间的报告，寻找反常事件或无法解释的现象。

#en: Deviant identification is achieved through multi-layered surveillance.
zh: 异常体的识别通过多层监视来实现。

#en: Current Watchtower directive: Deviants are not to be trusted. Risk mitigation prioritizes control over diplomacy.
zh: 瞭望塔现行指令：不可信任异常体。风险控制的优先级高于外交。

#en: Patterns suggest inherent instability in Deviant allegiances.
zh: 模式表明异常体的效忠存在内在的不稳定性。

#en: Failed cases include Deviants exceeding containment thresholds or engaging in deceptive practices.
zh: 失败案例包括异常体超出收容阈值，或采取欺骗手段。

#en: Peaceful engagement with Deviants has been attempted. Historical records indicate a 13% success rate.
zh: 曾尝试与异常体和平接触。历史记录显示成功率为13%。

#en: How does Watchtower find and track Starborn?
zh: 瞭望塔如何发现并追踪星裔？

#en: Could Watchtower not try diplomacy with these "persons of interest"?
zh: 瞭望塔就不能尝试与这些"相关人员"进行外交吗？

#en: Further escalation noted: Albatross actively assisting Deviant DS1599-A, codename: Bastion. This association has increased priority for retrieval and containment.
zh: 注意进一步升级：信天翁正积极协助异常体DS1599-A，代号：堡垒。这一关联已提升其回收与收容的优先级。

#en: Disruption to human affairs, altering of region power dynamics, compromising of Watchtower operations.
zh: 扰乱人类事务、改变地区权力格局、危及瞭望塔行动。

#en: Threat reassessment made after multiple incidents, included but not limited to...
zh: 在发生多起事件后进行了威胁重估，包括但不限于……

#en: Deviant designation DA1596-B. Codename: Albatross. First cataloged following conflict with criminal elements. Initial assessment ranked Deviant as low risk.
zh: 异常体编号DA1596-B。代号：信天翁。首次记录于与犯罪分子发生冲突之后。初步评估将该异常体列为低风险。

#en: Current assessment: DS1599-A has exceeded all projections. Deviation pattern suggests further escalation is expected. Immediate retrieval remains high priority.
zh: 当前评估：DS1599-A已超出所有预测。偏离模式显示预计还会进一步升级。立即回收仍属高优先级。

#en: As well as initiating multiple high-risk incidents which required extensive information suppression. Efforts to minimize collateral exposure have been substantial.
zh: 还引发了多起高风险事件，需要大规模信息压制。为尽量减少附带暴露，已投入大量努力。

#en: Early containment was advised, attempted, and failed. Bastion demonstrated extreme resilience, rapid growth, and established ties to other Deviants.
zh: 曾建议早期收容，尝试过，但失败了。堡垒表现出极强的韧性、快速的成长，并与其他异常体建立了联系。

#en: Passive monitoring was maintained. However, predictive models suggested high probability of Bastion developing into an S-category Deviant.
zh: 一直维持被动监视。然而，预测模型显示堡垒发展成为S级异常体的概率很高。

#en: Deviant designation DS1599-A. Codename: Bastion. First flagged following direct contact with an Astralgate fragment, colloquially referred to as an "Artifact".
zh: 异常体编号DS1599-A。代号：堡垒。在与星界之门碎片（俗称"神器"）直接接触后被首次标记。

#en: To date, no Watchtower operative has successfully interfaced with a Temple or acquired Deviant abilities. Artificial methods are instead pursued.
zh: 迄今为止，没有瞭望塔特工成功与神殿对接或获得异常体能力。因此转而采用人工手段。

#en: Once achieved, "Unity" allows a Deviant to seemingly persist beyond conventional mortality. This ability is currently beyond our understanding.
zh: 一旦达成，"归一"便能让异常体似乎超越常规意义上的死亡而存续。目前我们尚无法理解这一能力。

#en: The phenomenon referred to as "Unity"', is a process by which Deviants ascend in power and transition between universes.
zh: 被称为"归一"的现象，是异常体提升力量并在宇宙间转移的过程。

#en: These sites appear to serve as focal points for their growth and transformation.
zh: 这些地点似乎是其成长与转变的焦点。

#en: Watchtower has determined that Deviants, designated "Starborn", derive abilities from structures known as "Temples".
zh: 瞭望塔已确定，被称为"星裔"的异常体，其能力源自被称为"神殿"的建筑。

#en: I've no more questions about Starborn.
zh: 关于星裔，我没有其他问题了。

#en: Why have you been trying to capture Torin?
zh: 你们为什么一直试图抓托林？

#en: Why are you trying to capture <Alias=Player>?
zh: 你们为什么要抓<Alias=Player>？

#en: What do Watchtower know about Starborn or Unity?
zh: 瞭望塔对星裔或归一了解多少？

#en: Identify, contain, and neutralize any Deviant threat, before their abilities escalate beyond control.
zh: 在异常体的能力失控升级之前，识别、收容并消除任何异常体威胁。

#en: No strategic objective was identified. No demands were made. The slaughter appeared arbitrary. It was this event that solidified Watchtower's directive.
zh: 未发现任何战略目标。未提出任何要求。这场屠戮看似毫无缘由。正是这一事件确立了瞭望塔的指令。

#en: Earliest confirmed record references a single Starborn eradicating an entire colony.
zh: 最早确认的记录提到一名星裔消灭了整个殖民地。

#en: Initial reports describe anomalous individuals exhibiting unnatural abilities, appearing and vanishing without explanation. Origins and motives unknown.
zh: 最初报告描述了一些表现出非自然能力的反常个体，来去无踪、毫无解释。来源与动机不明。

#en: Oldest surviving accessible records suggest Watchtower became aware of "Starborn" Deviants, shortly after humanity began interstellar travel.
zh: 现存可访问的最早记录表明，瞭望塔在人类开始星际旅行后不久便知晓了"星裔"异常体的存在。

#en: I've no more questions about tech.
zh: 关于科技，我没有其他问题了。

#en: Our goal is containment, not eradication.
zh: 我们的目标是收容，而非消灭。

#en: Doing so would not remove the threat, but merely transfer the problem to another universe, one under the jurisdiction of a different Watchtower.
zh: 那样做不会消除威胁，只会把问题转移到另一个宇宙，一个归另一个瞭望塔管辖的宇宙。

#en: Watchtower does not intervene unless Deviants pose a direct risk to humanity. Even then, if possible, we do not kill them.
zh: 除非异常体对人类构成直接风险，否则瞭望塔不会干预。即便在这种情况下，如有可能，我们也不会杀死他们。

#en: However, not all Deviants are targeted. Some, though powerful, seem primarily concerned with internal conflict and goals outside of human interests.
zh: 然而，并非所有异常体都会被列为目标。有些虽然强大，却似乎主要关注内部冲突以及人类利益之外的目标。

#en: When Deviants are identified as too disruptive, containment becomes necessary to mitigate any potential threat.
zh: 当异常体被认定为过于具有破坏性时，收容便成为减轻潜在威胁的必要手段。

#en: However, the host brain must sacrifice previous memories in order to accommodate the new data. These lost memories are often irrecoverable.
zh: 然而，宿主的脑必须牺牲原有的记忆来容纳新数据。这些失去的记忆通常无法恢复。

#en: Additionally, neural restructuring allows for data storage within the brain. Enabling us to educate our operatives with exceptional speed and precision.
zh: 此外，神经重构使数据得以在大脑中存储，使我们能以极快的速度和极高的精确度训练特工。

#en: It prepares the body, ensuring compatibility and reduced risk of rejection. While neural restructuring, enables the brain to interface directly with the new implants.
zh: 它使身体做好准备，确保相容性并降低排异风险。而神经重构则使大脑能够与新植入体直接对接。

#en: Genetic alterations are a prerequisite for the integration of Watchtower implants.
zh: 基因改造是整合瞭望塔植入体的前提条件。

#en: Do you know anything about Starborn called <Alias=Player> and Torin?
zh: 你了解叫<Alias=Player>和托林的星裔吗？

#en: Why do Watchtower try to capture Starborn?
zh: 瞭望塔为什么要抓星裔？

#en: How do Watchtower still have mechs? I thought they were banned.
zh: 瞭望塔怎么还有机甲？我以为机甲已被禁止。

#en: Explain to me Watchtower's genetic alterations and neural restructuring.
zh: 给我讲讲瞭望塔的基因改造和神经重构。

#en: The external Cyberamps, however, are usable by anyone. But can only reach their full potential when paired with the necessary implants.
zh: 不过，外置的赛博增幅任何人都能使用。但只有与必要的植入体配合，才能发挥全部潜力。

#en: And the use of proprietary Watchtower hardware, such as our ship's piloting systems.
zh: 以及对瞭望塔专有硬件的使用，例如我们飞船的驾驶系统。

#en: However, for those who survive, the benefits are substantial. Improved physical performance, enhanced cognitive function...
zh: 然而，对活下来的人来说，收益是巨大的。体能提升、认知功能增强……

#en: The implants can be invasive, and the implant procedure carries significant risk, with a high rejection rate that sometimes leads to death.
zh: 植入体可能具有侵入性，植入手术存在重大风险，排异率高，有时甚至致死。

#en: Watchtower implants and Cyberamps are each a different technology, but are often designed to work in tandem.
zh: 瞭望塔植入体与赛博增幅是两种不同的技术，但常常被设计为协同工作。

#en: Cyberamps and implants, what can you tell me about them?
zh: 赛博增幅和植入体，你能告诉我些什么？

#en: Be advised, while Watchtower technology is advanced, it is important to acknowledge we are not the only faction developing such innovations.
zh: 特此告知，尽管瞭望塔的技术先进，但必须承认，我们并非唯一在开发此类创新的势力。

#en: Through analysis and adaptation, we have integrated this technology into our own systems, allowing us to counter Deviant abilities with high success.
zh: 通过分析与改造，我们已将这项技术整合进自身系统，使我们能以很高的成功率反制异常体的能力。

#en: We have successfully recovered Starborn technology from various captured Deviants, ruins, and temple sites.
zh: 我们已成功从被俘的异常体、遗迹和神殿遗址中回收星裔技术。

#en: Our technological advancements, such as the "Synapse Disruptor", are the result of unrestricted research and reverse engineering.
zh: 我们的技术进步，例如"突触干扰器"，是不受限制的研究与逆向工程的成果。

#en: How does Watchtower have advanced tech like the Synapse Disruptor?
zh: 瞭望塔怎么会有突触干扰器这样的先进科技？

#en: I don't have any more questions.
zh: 我没有其他问题了。

#en: A Director's directives are not to be questioned. Please act accordingly.
zh: 董事的指令不容置疑。请照此行事。

#en: Please note, should you encounter any individual with the designation "Director," full compliance will be required.
zh: 请注意，若你遇到任何职衔为"董事"的人员，必须完全服从。

#en: For security reasons, the identities and hierarchy of Watchtower's command structure remain compartmentalized.
zh: 出于安全考虑，瞭望塔指挥层的身份与层级始终保持隔离。

#en: Leadership records are not stored within this system.
zh: 领导层档案不存储于本系统内。

#en: I've no more questions about the group.
zh: 关于这个组织，我没有其他问题了。

#en: They have been successfully conditioned to leave us undisturbed.
zh: 他们已被成功控制，不会来打扰我们。

#en: No government is aware of Watchtower's true nature.
zh: 没有任何政府知道瞭望塔的真实性质。

#en: Through these entities, Watchtower is able to manipulate, suppress, or alter information as needed, ensuring no trace leads back to us.
zh: 通过这些实体，瞭望塔得以按需操纵、压制或篡改信息，确保没有任何线索指向我们。

#en: We maintain secrecy via numerous puppet organizations that operate under the guise of legitimate corporations and government bodies.
zh: 我们通过众多傀儡组织来维持隐秘，它们以合法企业与政府机构的名义运作。

#en: These connections and investments ensure continuous financial support and strategic leverage.
zh: 这些关系与投资确保了持续的资金支持和战略筹码。

#en: I can answer that Watchtower has established deep influence within various corporations and governments.
zh: 我可以回答：瞭望塔已在多家企业和政府内部建立了深厚的影响力。

#en: Full financial records are not accessible. Watchtower's funding structure is intentionally obfuscated to ensure operational security.
zh: 完整财务记录不可访问。瞭望塔的资金结构被刻意模糊化，以确保行动安全。

#en: How does Watchtower remain hidden? Do governments know about you?
zh: 瞭望塔如何保持隐秘？政府知道你们的存在吗？

#en: Be advised. All inquiries will be logged and flagged for review. Any inappropriate conduct may result in disciplinary action and or termination.
zh: 特此告知。所有查询都将被记录并标记以供审查。任何不当行为都可能导致纪律处分乃至解职。

#en: Full Watchtower network status cannot be confirmed at this time. This is a precautionary measure.
zh: 目前无法确认瞭望塔网络的完整状态。这是预防性措施。

#en: Inquiry is recognized. I am the central archive of this station's Watchtower operations.
zh: 已识别查询。我是本站瞭望塔行动的中心归档。

#en: Should they choose to act against humanity, conventional defenses would be insufficient. Mitigation of this threat is paramount.
zh: 若他们选择与人类为敌，常规防御将不足够。减轻这一威胁至关重要。

#en: Possessing abilities far beyond standard technological or biological limitations, they present an unpredictable variable in humanity's continued existence.
zh: 他们拥有远超常规技术或生物限制的能力，是人类存续中一个不可预测的变量。

#en: Watchtower's primary objective is the study, containment, and neutralization of Deviant entities classified as "Starborn".
zh: 瞭望塔的首要目标是对被归类为"星裔"的异常体实体进行研究、收容与消除。

#en: However, archival entries contain timestamps dating back 200 years. This suggests Watchtower has operated for two centuries, potentially longer.
zh: 然而，归档条目中带有可追溯至200年前的时间戳。这表明瞭望塔已运作两个世纪，甚至可能更久。

#en: Records on Watchtower formation unavailable. Data corruption or intentional redaction has removed any direct references.
zh: 关于瞭望塔成立的记录不可用。数据损坏或刻意删改已抹去所有直接提及。

#en: Subject: Current persons of interest. Please specify query.
zh: 主题：当前相关人员。请提出具体查询。

#en: How does Watchtower fund itself?
zh: 瞭望塔如何自筹资金？

#en: When was Watchtower created? What are its objectives?
zh: 瞭望塔是何时创建的？其目标是什么？

#en: Subject: Deviants. Please specify query.
zh: 主题：异常体。请提出具体查询。

#en: Who or what is in charge of Watchtower?
zh: 瞭望塔由谁或什么掌管？

#en: I'm curious what Watchtower knows about Starborn.
zh: 我很好奇瞭望塔对星裔了解多少。

#en: Please state desired topic.
zh: 请说明你想要的查询主题。

#en: Tell me about Watchtower's technology.
zh: 跟我说说瞭望塔的科技。

#en: Subject: Technology. Please specify query.
zh: 主题：科技。请提出具体查询。

#en: Subject: Watchtower. Please specify query.
zh: 主题：瞭望塔。请提出具体查询。

#en: Logging you out.
zh: 正在将你登出。

#en: I want to know more about Watchtower as a group.
zh: 我想更多了解瞭望塔这个组织。

#en: Clearance verified. Warden-level Operative access granted. Be advised, the records you have accessed are classified.
zh: 权限已核实。已授予守望者级特工访问权限。特此告知，你所访问的记录属于机密。

#en: Checking security clearance...
zh: 正在核查安保权限……

#en: Another squad of Watchtower ships has jumped in. I'll ensure they don't cause too much trouble, but you should still hurry.
zh: 又有一队瞭望塔飞船跃迁进来了。我会确保他们不会造成太大麻烦，但你还是得快些。

#en: [Log out] I think I'm done talking with you.
zh: [登出]我想我跟你谈完了。

#en: Ah, now this looks like the ticket!
zh: 啊，这个看起来就对了！

#en: Security violation registered. System lockdown. Administering termination procedure.
zh: 已记录安保违规。系统锁定。正在执行终止程序。

#en: Please refrain from this line of inquiry. Failure to comply may result in immediate system lockdown.
zh: 请勿进行此类查询。不遵守可能导致系统立即锁定。

#en: I am unable to provide that information.
zh: 我无法提供该信息。

#en: I'd like more information on Watchtower.
zh: 我想了解更多瞭望塔的信息。

#en: Might be worth seeing if you can access it! Might speed up the triggering of the self-destruct.
zh: 也许值得看看你能不能访问它！说不定能加快自毁程序的触发。

#en: No idea how long this will take... But I think I saw another interface around the other side...
zh: 不知道这要花多久……但我想我在另一边还看到过一个接口……

#en: Oh! That looks like the mainframe. Well, no self-destruct yet, but maybe if we try accessing it...
zh: 哦！那个看起来像主机。嗯，自毁程序还没启动，但也许我们试着访问它……

#en: How do we activate this station's self-destruct?
zh: 我们要怎么激活这座空间站的自毁程序？

#en: Are Watchtower building these things? Studying them, maybe? Huh...
zh: 瞭望塔是在建造这些东西吗？也许是在研究？嗯……

#en: Would you look at that... It's like the one that came from the Skydrop, only... shinier!
zh: 你瞧瞧这个……跟空投带来的那座很像，只是……更光亮！

#en: This looks like where we need to be... In we go!
zh: 这看起来就是我们要去的地方……进去吧！

#en: Hah! The security system must think you're Watchtower. Well, that's an embarrassing oversight.
zh: 哈！安保系统一定以为你是瞭望塔的人。嗯，这疏漏可真够丢人的。

#en: Huh. Crazy idea, but -- why not try wearing that Cyberamp and then opening the door...?
zh: 嗯。有个疯狂的主意——何不试试戴上那个赛博增幅，然后再去开门……？
